user.title: Connect to PitWatch
user.description: Make a token in PitWatch: open your profile page, find Home Assistant and other apps, pick the building, and press Make a token. Tick the box there if Home Assistant should be able to silence and reset the panel alarm.

data_description.url: Leave this alone unless you run your own PitWatch.
data_description.api_token: Starts with pw_. It is shown once, when it is made.

reauth_confirm.title: PitWatch needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description: PitWatch stopped accepting the token for {building}. It may have been revoked, or the account that made it lost access. Make a new one on your PitWatch profile page for the same building.

error.invalid_auth: PitWatch did not accept that token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach PitWatch at that address.
error.unknown: PitWatch answered in a way this did not expect.

abort.wrong_building: That token is for a different building.
